images.description: Two natural pointing hands inside an ivory clock dial. The index fingers themselves are the short coral hour and long mint minute hands. Based on Hiro's hand-drawn composition. The first crossed-arm portrait was rejected; the final runtime uses finger-focused version 3.
images.processing: Imagegen source 1024x1536 inspected. ffmpeg/libwebp resized to 768x1152 quality 86 for game art and 512x768 quality 82 for discovery. No paint-over or AI image edits outside Imagegen.

music.title: The Swing of Time
music.creator: ザイオン (zion)
music.conditions: The creator follows the site license. Commercial game background music and editing are permitted. No standalone audio distribution or listening feature. No secondary creator-tool provision of the music.
music.acquisition: Downloaded track 1 from the official download form using its supplied session/CSRF token on 2026-10-04. Track description, creator conditions, site license and terms reviewed. No message or usage report was sent to the creator.
music.processing: Opening 30 seconds, audio stream only; source embedded picture and metadata removed. Stereo 44.1kHz MP3 at 96kbit/s. loudnorm I=-23:TP=-2:LRA=11; 50ms fade-in and 29–30s fade-out.
music.delivery: Vite ?inline import in a lazy music JS chunk. Shared BGM ON/OFF, pause, loss of focus, tracking recovery, result and exit lifecycle. No standalone MP3 in public/dist, music player, recordings or creator export.

effects.title: tick_002.ogg
effects.creator: Kenney
effects.use: TICK on clock completion. Additional short success/rush chimes are original procedural Web Audio. SFX preference is separate from BGM.
